build_shapes3d_dataset: build the Shapes3d dataset builder to download and generate 64x64 RGB images with 7 discrete label attributes
create_shapes3d_builder: create a tfds GeneratorBasedBuilder instance for the Shapes3d dataset from the HDF5 file at https://storage.googleapis.com/3d-shapes/3dshapes.h5
test_shapes3d_dataset: test the Shapes3d dataset builder by generating examples with image and label features from the HDF5 source
review_shapes3d_builder: review the Shapes3d Builder class that implements _info, _split_generators, and _generate_examples for tfds.core.GeneratorBasedBuilder
summarize_shapes3d_features: summarize the Shapes3d dataset features including 64x64x3 images, 7 ClassLabel fields, and 7 float value fields
